title: Jane Eyre

vibeProfile.oneLine: An orphaned governess loves a brooding master with a secret in the attic.

summary: Orphaned, plain and fiercely independent, Jane Eyre survives a cruel childhood to become a governess at Thornfield Hall, where she falls for her brooding employer Mr Rochester and uncovers the terrible secret locked in his attic. Charlotte Bronte's novel was revolutionary for giving a poor, unglamorous woman a passionate inner voice and a demand to be treated as an equal. Gothic, romantic and morally uncompromising, it remains one of the most loved and most fiercely feminist of Victorian novels.
whyReadIt: A poor, plain heroine who insists on her own worth, and a Gothic romance that still burns. Revolutionary then, gripping now.

funFacts.text: Charlotte Bronte first published it under the male pen name Currer Bell.
